parameters.content:
## Inbound Lead Automation
1. Lead fills in the form
2. Rule-based score (0-100) → Hot / Warm / Cold
3. AI drafts a personal first email
4. Everything is logged to a Google Sheet (simple CRM)
5. Hot leads → instant email alert to sales
6. 3 days later → follow-up reminder

Set up: add OpenAI, Google Sheets and Gmail credentials, paste your Sheet URL and sales email.
